title: senecio chrysanthemifolius subsp. aethnensis
intro: Senecio chrysanthemifolius subsp. aethnensis, commonly known as Krios or Mountain Jerusalem Sage, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae, native to the mountainous regions of Greece. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relieving anxiety and stress, as well as its potential in promoting a good night's sleep due to its calming effects. The bioactive constituents of Krios include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Senecio chrysanthemifolius subsp. aethnensis are thought to be due to its ability to modulate the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues.
